name: @tbela99/rust-css-parser
description: Rust port of @tbela99/css-parser: monorepo of the rust library and its extensions css-parser-napi (node, deno, bun N-API) and css-parser-wasm (node, deno, bun and the browsers, WebAssembly)

scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:node && npm run test:web
scripts.test:node: npm run test:napi && npm run test:wasm
scripts.verify:napi: npm run build:napi && npm run test:napi
scripts.verify:wasm: npm run build:wasm && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:web
scripts.publish:napi:npm: npm run verify:napi && npm publish --workspace extensions/css-parser-napi --ignore-scripts
scripts.publish:napi:jsr: npm run verify:napi && cd extensions/css-parser-napi && jsr publish
scripts.publish:napi: npm run verify:napi && npm publish --workspace extensions/css-parser-napi --ignore-scripts && cd extensions/css-parser-napi && jsr publish
scripts.publish:wasm:npm: npm run verify:wasm && npm publish --workspace extensions/css-parser-wasm --ignore-scripts
scripts.publish:wasm:jsr: npm run verify:wasm && cd extensions/css-parser-wasm && jsr publish
scripts.publish:wasm: npm run verify:wasm && npm publish --workspace extensions/css-parser-wasm --ignore-scripts && cd extensions/css-parser-wasm && jsr publish
scripts.publish:npm: npm run publish:napi:npm && npm run publish:wasm:npm
scripts.publish:jsr: npm run publish:napi:jsr && npm run publish:wasm:jsr
scripts.publish:crate: npm run verify:crate && cargo publish -p rust-css-parser
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:crate && npm run publish:napi && npm run publish:wasm
scripts.publish:dry-run: npm run build && npm publish --workspaces --dry-run --ignore-scripts && (cd extensions/css-parser-napi && jsr publish --dry-run --allow-dirty) && (cd extensions/css-parser-wasm && jsr publish --dry-run --allow-dirty) && cargo publish -p rust-css-parser --dry-run --allow-dirty
scripts.syntax-update: cargo run --release --manifest-path scripts/Cargo.toml --bin webref && npm run syntax-compile
